sloka: इन्द्रमेवं ब्रुवाणं तं मान्धाता वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।क्व मे शक्र प्रतिहतं शासनं पृथिवीतले ।। ७.६७.१२ ॥
transliteration: indramevaṁ bruvāṇaṁ taṁ māndhātā vākyamabravīt ।kva me śakra pratihataṁ śāsanaṁ pṛthivītale ।। 7.67.12 ॥

translations.english: To Indra, who was speaking thus, Mandhata replied, "O Indra, where on the surface of the earth is my rule obstructed?"
